normalization.logical: JSON-visible BFS logical nodes; mapping keys Unicode-sorted; sequence order and timestamps retained
normalization.paths: Owned root prefix and observed API temporary PID/UUID suffixes only; receipt outputPath and metadataPath are paths
normalization.layouts: Every owned path, mode, file bytes and link count; normalized path bytes sorted; complete rows above 256 become count, JSON byte length and SHA-256
normalization.io: Named API arrivals including handle operations; nested implementation details of a filesystem API are not separate calls
normalization.limitations: No identity, authority, crash consistency, descriptor-lifetime or arbitrary OS-race proof
